items.source: An implementation of WebSocketHandler that delegates incoming WebSocket messages to a SubProtocolHandler along with a MessageChannel to which the sub-protocol handler can send messages from WebSocket clients to the application.
items.translation: 一个实现了 `WebSocketHandler` 的类，它将传入的 WebSocket 消息委托给一个 `SubProtocolHandler`，并附带一个 `MessageChannel`，子协议处理程序可以通过该通道将来自 WebSocket 客户端的消息发送到应用程序。

items.source: An implementation of WebSocketHandler that adds SockJS messages frames, sends SockJS heartbeat messages, and delegates lifecycle events and messages to a target WebSocketHandler.
items.translation: 实现 `WebSocketHandler` 的类，用于添加 SockJS 消息帧、发送 SockJS 心跳消息，并将生命周期事件和消息委托给目标`WebSocketHandler`。

items.source: Uses of SubProtocolCapable in org.springframework.web.socket.messaging
items.translation: `org.springframework.web.socket.messaging` 包中 `SubProtocolCapable` 的用法

items.source: Uses of SubProtocolCapable in org.springframework.web.socket.sockjs.transport.handler
items.translation: `org.springframework.web.socket.sockjs.transport.handler` 包中 `SubProtocolCapable` 的用法

items.source: TransportHandler implementation classes as well as a concrete SockJsService.
items.translation: `TransportHandler` 实现类以及具体的 `SockJsService`。

items.source: WebSocket integration for Spring's messaging module.
items.translation: Spring 消息模块的 WebSocket 集成。
